title: Positivity of an expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be nonnegative everywhere. If there is some $x\in\Omega$ with $p(x)\ne 0$ and $f(x)>0$, then the expectation of $f$ under $p$ is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
